sources.label: Capital One Savor official product page
Capital One 2018 legacy Savor launch announcement

reviewNotes: This definition represents the currently marketed Capital One Savor product with a $0 annual fee. It is not the discontinued legacy Savor product launched with a $95 annual fee after the first year and a 4% dining and entertainment earn rate; existing cardholders should verify the product name and fee on their statement or current terms before selecting this catalog entry. The current product's uncapped cash-back earning rates are not recurring fixed-value benefits, and its new-card bonus is a one-time acquisition offer, so neither is included. The image is official Capital One card art from https://ecm.capitalone.com/WCM/card/products/new-savor-card-art/mobile.png. Rollout disposition: synchronization creates one card and no benefits; benefit status propagation and usage-guide linkage are not applicable. No database synchronization was run as part of this intake.
